gmgn_cli.stdout_head:
Usage: gmgn-cli [options] [command]

GMGN OpenAPI CLI — market data, token info, portfolio, track KOL/smart money
trades, and swap

Options:
  -V, --version         output the version number
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  token                 Token information commands
  market                Market data commands
  portfolio             Wallet portfolio commands
  track                 On-chain tracking commands: follow-wallet trades, KOL
                        t

onchainos.stdout_head:
onchainOS CLI - interact with OKX Web3 backend

Usage: onchainos [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  market       Market data: prices, charts, wallet PnL
  signal       Smart money / whale / KOL signal tracking
  memepump     Meme / pump.fun token scanning and analysis
  leaderboard  Leaderboard (top traders ranked by PnL, win rate, or volume)
  token        Token information
  swap         DEX swap
  cross-chain  Cross-chain bridge swap
  gateway      On-chain gateway
  portfolio    Wallet portfol
